Why They Beg to Be Ruled

The COVID theater wasn't just about public health. It was psychological warfare revealing humanity's deepest programming: the desperate need to be ruled by external authority.

Most people didn't resist the lockdowns, mandates, and experimental injections. They begged for them. They attacked anyone who questioned. They turned their children over to the system without hesitation.

Why?

THE AUTHORITY WORSHIP PROGRAM:

Scripture warned us:

“My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge” Hosea 4:6

But it's deeper than ignorance, it's willful dependence.

CHILDHOOD INSTALLATION: Twelve years of school system conditioning. Sit still. Don't question. Trust the teacher. Raise your hand for permission to think. External validation becomes survival mechanism.

COGNITIVE LOAD OUTSOURCING: Independent thinking requires massive mental energy. Research. Analysis. Consequence-bearing. Most people prefer surrendering decision-making to "experts" rather than doing the work themselves.

SOCIAL PROOF DEPENDENCY: They need herd validation for psychological safety. When "everyone" wears masks, individual conscience gets overridden by group conformity. Being different feels like death.

“You shall not follow a crowd to do evil” Exodus 23:2

Yet most people will violate their own conscience to maintain social acceptance. The crowd becomes their god.

MORTALITY SALIENCE WEAPONIZATION: Babylon discovered the ultimate trigger: existential fear. "You could die" bypasses all rational analysis and activates primitive compliance circuits.

THE COVID PSYOP PHASES:

PHASE 1 - FEAR INSTALLATION
24/7 death counters. Overwhelmed hospital footage. "Flatten the curve" urgency programming. Terror became the emotional baseline.

PHASE 2 - AUTHORITY POSITIONING
Only "scientists" and "doctors" could speak truth. Anyone questioning got labeled "conspiracy theorist" or "anti-science." Dissent became heresy against the new priesthood.

“Thus says the Lord: ‘Cursed is the man who trusts in man and makes flesh his strength, whose heart departs from the Lord’” Jeremiah 17:5

They transferred faith from God to government experts.

PHASE 3 - COMPLIANCE REWARDS
Masks became virtue signals. Vaccination became social membership badges. Following orders got rewarded with "freedoms." Obedience became identity.

PHASE 4 - DISSENT PUNISHMENT
Social ostracism. Job termination. Family division. Pure behavioral conditioning: comply or suffer consequences.

THE DEEPER PSYCHOLOGICAL REVELATION:

Most people want to be ruled. Freedom requires responsibility, decision-making, risk assessment, and consequence-bearing. Authority worship provides psychological comfort, someone else carries the burden of choice.

“They said to Samuel, ‘Now appoint a king to lead us, such as all the other nations have’” 1 Samuel 8:5

Israel rejected God's direct rule for human kingship. Same psychology, different century.

STOCKHOLM SYNDROME AT CIVILIZATIONAL SCALE: After enough compliance cycles, people develop emotional attachment to their controllers. Questioning authority becomes questioning their own identity and worldview.

The same people who claimed "my body, my choice" for abortion suddenly demanded everyone inject experimental substances. The contradiction doesn't matter. Consistency isn't the goal. Submission to current authority is the goal.

THE REMNANT OPERATES DIFFERENTLY:

INTERNAL AUTHORITY STRUCTURE: Torah principles, Holy Spirit discernment, conscience activation. We don't need external validation for truth recognition.

“But when He, the Spirit of truth, comes, He will guide you into all the truth” John 16:13

The remnant has internal navigation systems that don't depend on Babylon's "experts."

PATTERN RECOGNITION TRAINING: We're conditioned to test everything against Scripture, not trust human institutions claiming divine authority.

“Test all things; hold fast what is good” 1 Thessalonians 5:21

This isn't suggestion. It's command protocol for covenant people.

HISTORICAL AWARENESS: We study how previous generations got deceived by similar authority claims. We recognize the patterns.

COVENANT COMMUNITY: We have support systems that don't depend on Babylon's approval. We can resist because we're not isolated.

STRATEGIC INTELLIGENCE FOR FUTURE PSYOPS:

The same psychological triggers will activate with different crises:

  • Climate emergency lockdowns
  • Economic collapse "temporary measures"
  • Cyber attack "digital safety protocols"
  • Food shortage "rationing for equity"

THE MECHANISM NEVER CHANGES:

  • Create crisis (real or manufactured)
  • Position authority as savior
  • Reward compliance with "safety"
  • Punish dissent with isolation
  • Make submission feel like virtue

THE REMNANT RESPONSE:

We don't argue with authority worshippers, their psychology prevents rational discussion. We build parallel systems. We create covenant communities. We prepare alternatives.

“Come out of her, my people, lest you share in her sins, and lest you receive of her plagues” Revelation 18:4

The remnant separates from Babylon's systems before judgment falls.

When the next crisis comes, we won't be begging for salvation from the same systems that created the problem.

KINGDOM INTELLIGENCE: Most people will choose comfortable slavery over uncomfortable freedom every single time. This isn't weakness, it's programming.

Understanding this psychology prepares us to lead during collapse, not argue during deception.

The remnant doesn't need permission to think.

Authority worship is spiritual bondage. The Kingdom operates through covenant relationship, not institutional submission. Build accordingly.
